try: Open {url}. The experiment frame-proposals is ON for this demo only (/flag shows it). Send a message, e.g. "what about keeping the claim local?": within about a second the reasoning map shows a dashed lavender note "model suggests: focus dec-2 · order dec-2, …", marked "suggested by morrow, not by you". Nothing has changed yet.

Apply it: click a card in the map (or press Tab from the empty input until the dashed note is outlined, 3 presses), then press f; or use the "apply" button on the note. The map reorders, dec-2 is marked, and the pane bar says who suggested the frame and that you applied it. "dismiss" drops a proposal instead.
/why map explains the applied frame: who suggested it, from which message, who applied it and when, with sources. /frame lists frames per pane.
/frame reset map puts the map back in its own order (recorded in {dir}/frames.json). /flag frame-proposals off: no frame is proposed or shown.
